GeneDef.label: Survival Instinct
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have an instinctive fear of conflict and a strong aversion to being restrained and fighting. When the enemy approaches, they will feel panic and their adrenaline secretion will be greatly increased to facilitate their escape.

customEffectDescriptions.li: When the distance from hostile units is within 20 grids, the mobility will be improved, but the operational ability will decrease.

GeneDef.label: Agricultural Passion
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have an extremely outstanding perceptual talent for plants, and the instincts hidden within their genes make them far superior to ordinary people in agricultural work.

GeneDef.label: Diligent by nature
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have an extra passion for work and are unable to adapt to a life that does not require labor.

GeneDef.label: Unconventional structure
GeneDef.description: Although there is no difference in appearance, carriers of this gene actually have certain differences in body structure and tissue composition compared to normal people, so they cannot enjoy the technological improvements of the shaping chamber.

GeneDef.label: Monarchy based
GeneDef.description: The instinct in genes drives carriers to advance towards power, and when they gain control, their perception will become more sensitive.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Gain when obtaining noble titles or cultural positions.

GeneDef.label: Inspiration inspires
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are easily inspired while working, and their neural circuits are much more complex than those of normal individuals.

customEffectDescriptions.li: After completing any forging or sewing work, there is a small probability of obtaining a creative inspiration, and the higher the mood, the higher the probability of obtaining it.
This effect will not overwrite existing inspirations.
There is a 20 day cooling period after each trigger.

GeneDef.label: Oversensitive
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene always have doubts about others, find it difficult to establish romantic relationships, and find it difficult to accept sharing the same bedroom with others.
